description: Authorize consequential AI agent actions before execution
name: com.decionis/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the policy file; defaults to ./DECIONIS_POLICY.md in the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_POLICY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Optional Presence tenant API key. When set, decionis_request_presence_verification and decionis_get_presence_verification_status register and call presence.decionis.com; without it the server stays networkless.
environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_PRESENCE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Presence base URL (https only); defaults to https://presence.decionis.com.
environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_PRESENCE_API_URL
